notes: Both coders set delegates for both documents. Matched units differed mainly on policy_type (P41 vs P32 for skill-building vs stay-the-thinker sentences, P56 vs P77 for the not-a-policy status sentence, P03 vs P53 for the use-deliberately rule, P52 vs P50 for the IP/privacy/ethics clause), and on phase (general vs during-work or before-course for list items, verify-output and the faculty-role sentence). Resolved by re-reading the source: one rule per unit (the 'strengthen their thinking... remain responsible for evaluating' sentence was split into P32 and P31), P41 for skill-building rationale, P56 for status/scope statements, P03 for discouragement without a ban. All six units found only by A (rationale or commitment sentences, one UNCOVERED support commitment) and two found only by B were real statements and were kept. Fit notes from both coders were merged.
